name: Chit funds

subjectOf.text: Applying Web3 technology to chit funds replaces the foremen and their commission with smart contracts, which eliminates the risk that a foreman absconds with the fund.
subjectOf.abstract: First, smart contracts replace the foremen and their d% commission, eliminating the risk of a foreman absconding with the fund.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
scope_conditions: chit fund style rotating savings and lending schemes

subjectOf.text: Member default on premia is a major inefficiency in chit funds, with estimates that a large share of subscribers have defaulted at least once recently and a substantial share have defaulted after winning an auction.
subjectOf.abstract: It's been estimated that Td% of chit fund sub- scribers have defaulted at least once recently and 9e% have defaulted after winning an auction.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
scope_conditions: chit fund participants, per the cited study

subjectOf.text: A decentralized chit fund can let people bootstrap financial security with no initial reserve backing, but only if the reputation system is strong enough to hold defaults to a low percentage.
subjectOf.abstract: With no initial reserve backing, this allows people to bootstrap their way to greater financial security and stability, assuming the reputation system is sufficiently strong to guarantee a low percentage of defaults.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
scope_conditions: requires a sufficiently strong reputation system
